test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Giving a false alarm

options.text: A situation when people ring an alarm bell to frighten everybody just for fun
A situation when people wrongly think that something bad is going to happen
A situation when people don't think that something is good and the opposite happens
A situation when things go wrong and everything bad happens

solution:
The correct answer is **'****A situation when people wrongly think that something bad is going to happen'**.
